name: Fawaz Ahmed Quran API
description: High-speed, CDN-backed static REST-style JSON Quran API providing access to the Holy Quran in original Arabic, 440+ translations across 90+ languages, transliterations, and structural divisions (Juz, Surah, Ayah, Ruku, Sajda, Pages). Hosted on jsDelivr with infinite scaling.

endpoints.name: List All Editions
endpoints.description: Returns all 440+ translation and recitation editions with language, author, direction, and edition slug.

endpoints.name: Get Complete Quran Edition
endpoints.description: Returns all 6,236 verses for a given edition in a single request.

endpoints.name: Get Full Chapter (Surah)
endpoints.description: Returns all verses of a specified Surah.

endpoints.name: Get Specific Verse (Ayah)
endpoints.description: Returns a single Ayah by chapter and verse number.

endpoints.name: Get Juz
endpoints.description: Returns all verses within a given Juz (1-30).
